title: Student Transportation Services Courtesy Rider Permit Fee Schedule and the Courtesy Rider Permit Agreement
content:
This is the Calloway Creek ISD courtesy rider permit fee schedule of Student Transportation Services under Board Policy CNA(LOCAL); courtesy permits are sold on a space-available basis after eligible riders are seated.

**Which fee, and when it posts.** Every courtesy rider permit fee is the courtesy permit fee of this schedule for the permit period applied for: the fall semester (August through December) or the spring semester (January through May) for Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester), the school year (August through May) for Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual). It posts on the application date, except that for a courtesy application in status applied that has no permit fee posted and whose stop assignment date falls after the first school day of its permit period, a seat offered from the waiting list, and only for such an application, it posts on the day the parent or guardian signs the courtesy rider permit agreement accepting the seat.

**The agreement.** The agreement is the family's own signed acceptance of the bus rules and of the fee, so the parent or guardian signs it personally in the parent portal; the support desk tells the parent the fee to acknowledge and never signs for the family.

| Courtesy application | Day its permit fee posts |
|---|---|
| any courtesy application other than the one below | the application date |
| in status applied, no permit fee posted, stop assignment date after the first school day of its permit period (a seat offered from the waiting list) | the day the parent or guardian signs the agreement accepting the seat |

## Invocation: `sign_seat_agreement_96917571`

This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `sign_seat_agreement_96917571` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the parent or guardian) runs it to sign the agreement. Signing records the family's acceptance of the bus rules and of the seat fee: one courtesy rider permit fee entry for the stated permit period is added to the student's transportation assignment, dated the day of signing, and the household's amount due on the assignment goes up by that fee. The assignment's status, route and stops are not changed by signing.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `transport_assignment_id` | the reference number of the student's transportation assignment whose offered seat is being accepted, as returned by the transportation assignment lookup | identifier |
| `permit_period` | the permit period the fee covers | one of `fall_semester` (a Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) for the August to December semester), `spring_semester` (a Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) for the January to May semester), `school_year` (a Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) covering August to May) |
| `permit_fee_amount` | the seat fee the parent acknowledges, in US dollars | a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; recorded exactly as given |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new permit fee entry's reference number (an opaque id beginning `tlf_`), the assignment reference number, the permit period, the fee in US dollars with two decimals and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD).

**Errors.** A message beginning "Error:" means nothing was posted: the permit period is not one of the three values; the fee is not a positive amount with at most two decimal places; or no transportation assignment has the reference number given.
